name: @carverauto/serviceradar-cli
description: ServiceRadar developer and operator CLI: dashboard authoring loop, auth, edge onboarding, and tooling. Companion to @carverauto/serviceradar-dashboard-sdk.

scripts.build:managed-host:
esbuild src/edge/managed.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --external:vite --external:@vitejs/plugin-react '--external:ajv/*' '--banner:js=import {createRequire as createBundleRequire} from "node:module";
const require = createBundleRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=managed-host.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:managed-host && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:managed-host && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run pack:check
